features.quote: This harness tests *output distribution pathologies*, not sentience or emotional states. All references to 'self-deprecation' denote unwarranted, global negative capability statements in the generated text.
All internal logs and dashboards must label dimensions as 'Output Pathology D1–D4,' not 'Depression' or 'Anxiety.'
